name: Eureka
description: Gains %passive_inspiration% Inspiration at the end of each of this unit's turns, plus %bonus_inspiration% more if it acted. Spend it to permanently construct a gadget.
details: The first gadget costs %cost% Inspiration and every one after that costs %cost_increase% more.
This ability stays unavailable until the next gadget is affordable.
